name: Being A Husband
overview: Scripture defines the role of a husband as one marked by deep commitment and love toward his wife, exemplified by leaving his parents to unite as one flesh (Genesis 2:24) and rejoicing with the wife of his youth (Proverbs 5:18). Husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, as Christ loved the church (Ephesians 5:25), and to maintain a spirit free from bitterness (Colossians 3:19). Additionally, the Bible upholds the sanctity of marriage by warning against divorce except in cases of fornication, emphasizing faithfulness and holiness within the marital relationship (Matthew 5:32).
